name: Jataayu Security Guard
description: ENFORCED inbound prompt-injection gate (blocks HIGH-risk turns before the agent runs) + advisory inbound/outbound tools. Fail-open.

python.description: Path to Python interpreter with jataayu installed (e.g. a conda/venv python)

jataayuPath.description: Optional path to the jataayu package if not importable on sys.path

protectedNames.description: Names/tickers the outbound guard should redact from shared surfaces

blockOnInboundHigh.description: Enforced: block the turn when Jataayu flags HIGH prompt-injection risk. Fail-open on errors. Set false for warn/log-only.
